items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: "I Put A Spell on You with Screaming Jay Hawkins... Then I did, 'Where Are You' with Dinah Washington."

ctx.x: But that was the first time -- "I Put A Spell on You with Screaming Jay Hawkins. Then I did, "Where Are You" with Dinah Washington.
"Where Are You? Yeah, I did that, too.
